system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Domain expertise is encoded in structured prompts organized by phase (bootstrap, explore, finalize)
system_prompt_style.note: The paper describes phase-specific prompts. It does not describe the rendering mechanism, and the EoG prompt code is not in the pinned Codex evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Local Markov Property: it contains entity metadata, 1-
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value only. The controller injects a per-node Context Packet (entity metadata, 1-hop neighbours, time-windowed observability data, inbox) fetched through the Context Contract. The LLM does not navigate. This is harness-driven graph retrieval, which no listed value covers.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Large contexts (>80K tokens) are chunked with overlap and classified via map-reduce.
context_compaction.note: The policy is stateless per node, and the persistent state is the explanatory graph plus the ledger, which is closest to structured_checkpoint. Map-reduce over chunks is coded as summarize.

observation_format.note: Inferred from textual logs, metrics and events. The serialisation format is not specified.

tool_call_format.note: The paper does not state the policy output syntax. EoG code is not in the evidence.

tool_count.note: EoG uses the MCP tool get_context_contract. Under the counting rule, MCP tools do not count. No native tool list was available.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the agent cannot execute arbitrary code;
edit_primitive.note: The agent can only request data through the Context Contract, so it has no file-editing capability.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The CxC is implemented as an MCP tool

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: We implement domain-specific MCP servers exposing the operational graph and evidence data

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: When new evidence changes a node’s belief, it broadcasts to neighbors,
loop_primitives.note: A deterministic controller runs a worklist loop over the graph, and belief-change messages re-activate neighbours. No listed value fits exactly.

planning_granularity.note: The controller maintains the ActiveSet worklist.

multi_agent_topology.note: One stateless LLM policy is invoked per node, plus a finalize policy. There is no delegation.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: which execute graph traversal, message routing, and termination logic without semantic rea-
delegation_mechanism.note: Messages are belief records between graph nodes, not between agents.

human_in_loop.note: The evidence is paper only for EoG. The host framework Codex has approvals, but EoG's configuration is unknown.

long_term_memory.note: No EoG config surface is in the evidence.

self_verification.note: The damping heuristic (Defer after flips) is not verification.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: convergence (no new messages) or budget exhaustion
termination_condition.note: The budget is the maximum number of investigation hops. The run also ends at a fixed point (no pending messages), which is controller convergence and has no listed value.

execution_isolation.note: The paper does not state the execution boundary for EoG.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the agent cannot execute arbitrary code;
filesystem_access.note: The agent only requests observational data. This is inferred from prose.

permission_model.evidence_quote: it can only request data via the Context Contract
permission_model.note: The controller restricts the policy to a fixed tool interface.

tracing.note: The Global Ledger records (v, Bv, t) tuples.

replayability.evidence_quote: scratchpad (Nye et al., 2021) enables replay, debugging,

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on ITBench, but no EoG repository is available to check for an evaluation runner.

target_domain.evidence_quote: On representative ITBench diagnostics tasks, EoG improves accuracy
target_domain.note: The domain is IT incident diagnosis (SRE). The paper mentions an extension to SWE production bugs.

open_source.note: The host framework Codex is Apache-2.0. Release of the EoG code is not stated.

model_agnostic.note: The paper evaluates EoG with GPT-5.1, GPT-OSS, Gemini, Kimi, Minimax and Mistral.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We implement the EoG agent and a baseline ReAct agent on the Codex agent framework,
primary_artifact.note: The supplied repository is the Codex host framework, not EoG code.

first_release_date.note: Only the v2 date (29 Jan 2026) appears in the evidence. The v1 date is not given.

pinned_version.note: The evidence pins openai/codex tag rust-v0.153.0-alpha.2 @73919571da60 (2026-08-31). That is the host framework, and no EoG code is pinned.

stars.note: The 125294 stars belong to openai/codex, not an EoG repository.
